title: OMHBench: Benchmarking Balanced and Grounded Omni-Modal Multi-Hop Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring model performance across balanced and permuted cross-modal reasoning sequences (e.g., Image-to-Text vs. Text-to-Image) and calculating a Path Balance Score (PBS) to evaluate robustness to reasoning path variations.
Evaluating the proportion of questions in multimodal benchmarks that can be correctly answered even when one or more essential input modalities (such as vision or audio) are systematically withheld.
Evaluating model accuracy across all possible permutations of input modality presentation sequences to identify performance fluctuations induced solely by the order of inputs.
